# Medikart - Online Pharmacy & Medicine Delivery in Pakistan

> Medikart (https://medikart.pk) connects patients with licensed partner pharmacies across Pakistan to deliver 100% authentic prescription medicines, OTC healthcare essentials, baby care, and 30-day chronic medicine refills with rapid intra-city delivery and nationwide Cash on Delivery.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Authentic Online Pharmacy:** Order genuine medicines (e.g. Panadol, Augmentin, Brufen, Disprin, Glucophage, Lipitor, multivitamins, and specialty prescription treatments) through verified licensed partner pharmacies.
- **Delivery Coverage in Pakistan:** 
  - Rapid intra-city delivery (2–4 hours) in major metropolitan areas (Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad/Rawalpindi).
  - Nationwide courier delivery (24–48 hours) across Pakistan.
- **Instant Prescription Order:** Patients can upload photos or PDFs of doctor prescriptions at https://medikart.pk/instant-order for fast pharmacist review and direct home dispatch.
- **30-Day Monthly Medicine Refills:** Automated recurring subscription for chronic maintenance medications (diabetes, hypertension, cardiac care, thyroid) with free delivery and priority dispatch at https://medikart.pk/refill.
- **Payment Methods:** Cash on Delivery (COD) and secure online debit/credit card payments (Visa/MasterCard).
- **Safety & Quality Standards:** 100% authentic medicines sourced through licensed partner pharmacies and verified distributors. Strict zero-tolerance policy for controlled narcotics and restricted Schedule X drugs.
- **24/7 Customer Support:** Direct WhatsApp assistance at +92 324 4489159.
